supersedes_output: v1 was interrupted after setup and the first ORB cold repetition to separate image preparation from detection/description; v2 was interrupted during ORB setup to also separate ALIKED field estimation, topology/QC, and accuracy-evaluation timing. Neither superseded output contains a complete measured comparison.

sequence.schedule: ascending acquisition time; only adjacent pairs are evaluated
sequence.geographic_domain: For each pair, the physics-reachable intersection of the identical source and target standard-VAE image footprints; normalization and accuracy use the exact common valid 4 km ORB/ALIKED nodes.

orb_policy.model: legacy homography fit in kilometre-conditioned coordinates

aliked_policy.feature_cache: one deterministic cache record per image tile
aliked_policy.matching: physics-conditioned LightGlue with sequential preceding-field prior
aliked_policy.prior_source: median velocity of only the immediately preceding accepted fold-free ALIKED field
aliked_policy.fallback: full absolute 30 km/day physics window when prior is absent, noncontiguous/stale, or the preceding field is inconsistent
aliked_policy.estimator: nearest 12 within 6 km with at least 8 vectors coherent within 1 km
aliked_policy.persistence: per-image cache, per-pair matches/fields/audits, and run manifest enabled

timing_design.cold_definition: A distinct initially empty deterministic detector-feature/grid cache for every measured repetition; model weights remain locally installed.
timing_design.warm_definition: The setup run populates one shared deterministic detector-feature/grid cache, reused without modification by all measured repetitions.

normalization: seconds per square kilometre of exact common valid 4 km support
seconds per 1000 accepted exact-common 4 km vectors
accuracy_outputs: cycle closure where the sequence supplies a cycle
ORB/ALIKED vector agreement on exact common support
multisensor statistics on exact common support
interpretation_guard: No speed percentage is operational until the sequential-prior held sequence and absent/stale/inconsistent fallback audits pass. CUDA results must be measured separately and never inferred from CPU.
